carla: Heads-up — our rekey run started for cmk-prod-eu at 04:12 UTC. Ops-bot raised an alert that a canary snapshot restore in staging failed right after the rotation.
ops-bot: Alert: snapshot-restore-failure detected for tenant-17; error=DECRYPTION_ERROR; trace_id=trk-94f.
carla: Repro steps attached — I tried a manual restore and saw "unable to decrypt object metadata: missing cmek-header".
darren: @carla can you paste the exact error log and which storage key version was active? Also which uploader SA was used for that snapshot?
carla: log snippet: ```2026-03-21T04:15:02Z restore-agent[pid=322]: decrypt failed: kms.VerifyKeyVersion(versions/14) -> permission denied
2026-03-21T04:15:02Z restore-agent: object metadata: cmek-kv = null```
carla: Uploader SA = backup-uploader@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com, restore ran under restore-service@redwood-staging.iam.gserviceaccount.com
ben: This smells like a grant/role timing issue — during rekey we rotated primary key and created a new key version but didn't propagate the IAM binding to the uploader SA in the eu region because of the per-region grant PR that landed last week.
alice: We saw a similar edge case where cross-project grants were missing audit logging entries because the audit sink filter excluded admin serviceaccounts. Might be related.
darren: @ben can you check KMS IAM for both key versions? run: ```gcloud kms keys versions list cmk-prod-eu --location=eu --keyring=prod-rk --format=json```
ben: Ran that; key version 14 (new) state=ENABLED but IAM policy only shows grant to restore-service, not backup-uploader. Old version 13 has grant to backup-uploader.
carla: So snapshot objects written before rotation reference the old version, but restores referencing new default version are failing because restore path expects decrypt with new default? Confusing.
darren: Two hypotheses: (1) The restore flow is trying to decrypt with default key version instead of using per-object encryption header. (2) Object metadata lost cmek header during copy/replication step in lifecycle. We need to validate object metadata on a failed snapshot.
carla: I inspected the offending object: metadata block has cmek: "", header missing. The uploader service logged a 2xx on upload — possible metadata strip during cross-region replication job.
ben: Action: restore pipeline should fallback to key-version-specific decrypt. Also add a short-circuit check to surface missing cmek metadata at upload time.
alice: For the RBAC part — we should avoid granting broad iam.roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter to uploader SA on all versions. Instead use granular per-key-version grants via IAM conditions short-term during rotation.
darren: For immediate mitigation: (1) Re-add grant for backup-uploader to key version 14, (2) run canary restores for 10 snapshots, (3) run a query to find snapshots with empty cmek metadata. I'll open a follow-up ticket.
carla: Also enable an audit log filter for kms.cryptoKeyVersions.decrypt and create an alert when decrypt denies occur for restore-service or backup-uploader.
ops-bot: Ticket created: #INC-7231 — "Rekey propagation & missing cmek metadata — mitigation" assigned to @darren, priority=high. :eyes:
incident-bot: Noted: add postmortem if >3 tenants impacted.
ben: Quick workaround for staging: re-run restore with explicit key version param `--kms-key-version=projects/.../locations/eu/keyRings/prod-rk/cryptoKeys/cmk-prod-eu/cryptoKeyVersions/13`
darren: We'll also add a nightly job to scan object-store for metadata drift (empty cmek header). Query: `gsutil ls -L gs://snapshots-prod/** | grep -A3 "CMEK"` as a short-term check.
alice: Long term: update replication job to preserve object metadata, add unit tests for copy path, and ensure rotation runs include a gated RBAC propagation step with automated verification.
carla: I've attached the restore test matrix and will run the canary list after the grant is fixed. Thanks all.
ben: I'll file the PR to add the per-rotation CI check and the audit-logs filter.
darren: I'll coordinate the immediate grants and run the canary. Will update INC-7231 when done.
carla: Closing loop — remember to update runbooks: rekey playbook should include explicit `propagate-iam` and `verify-metadata-preservation` steps. :white_check_mark:
